title: Which side is open interest picking? (2026-10-30)
how: Not re-run. Numbers and sentences below were copied from the committed source note; the verdict is the line as written there.

verdict.label: These are descriptive counts only: no fees and no edge claim. Definitions are in the header of study.py (all OURS).

why: These are descriptive counts only: no fees and no edge claim. Definitions are in the header of study.py (all OURS).
What differs is who was in a hurry (the aggressor, seen in the taker delta) and who absorbed (the passive side, seen when price does not move).
Direction: every row sits between 48% and 54%. OI, with or without price, did not tell the next direction.
Sellers aggressive while price does not fall, with OI rising (the shot): that is passive buyers absorbing new shorts (Fabio F-CVD3).
